crossRefs.note: “Ataroth, Dibon, Jazer, Nimrah, Heshbon, Elealeh, Sebam, Nebo, and Beon,
Build cities for your little ones, and folds for your sheep; and do that which has proceeded out of your mouth.”

people.name: Beth-haram
people.line: Town in Gad, east of the Jordan, fortified by Gad.

people.name: Beth-nimrah
people.line: Town in Gad, east of the Jordan River.

translations.web: Beth Nimrah, and Beth Haran: fortified cities and folds for sheep.
translations.bsb: Beth-nimrah, and Beth-haran as fortified cities, and they built folds for their flocks.
translations.kjv: And Bethnimrah, and Bethharan, fenced cities: and folds for sheep.
translations.asv: and Beth-nimrah, and Beth-haran: fortified cities, and folds for sheep.
